from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's full title as written")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
